title: Base Azul contract-deployments scope walk
summary: Walked /contract-deployments/zeronet active-Azul deploy bundles (activate-multiproof, upgrade-tee-registry-nitro, fix-nitro-verifier, fix-tee-image-hash). All 4 are MultisigScripts gated on PROXY_ADMIN_OWNER. DeployMultiproofStack uses atomic Proxy + upgradeToAndCall pattern: impl constructor calls initialize with dEaD addresses (consumes initializer modifier), proxy without impl no-op delegates to address(0), no frontrun window. MockVerifier in zeronet is documented testnet design. Mainnet planned May 13, not yet deployed.
key_lesson: Deploy scripts in well-engineered codebases (OP Stack derivatives) are atomic-by-design via the OZ Proxy + upgradeToAndCall pattern. Frontrun analysis on these is usually wasted effort; the surface is feasibility-gated by the multisig threshold. Skip deploy-script walks for OP Stack forks UNLESS the contest explicitly elevates them above multisig-mandate carve-out.
